newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazilian real drops 0.58 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Brazilian real drops 0.58 pct in June.

text.p: Brazil's real closed at 1.0766 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market, down 0.02 percent on the day and 0.58 percent for the month, dealers said.
Earlier today the Central Bank depreciated the mini-band by 0.09 percent to between 1.0765 and 1.0815 reais per dollar. The mini-band fell 0.61 percent during June, the same as in May.

The real fell by less than the mini-band on Monday because banks who had held dollars in the last few days sold them in order to arbitrage with the forex futures market. Monday's closing price in the futures market will be used on July contracts to be settled on Tuesday, dealers said.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0819 per greenback, down 0.06 percent on the day and 0.59 percent for the month.
In the parallel market, the real closed at 1.135 per dollar, unchanged from Friday, but 0.44 percent down from May.
